name: Myrtle Grove: A Clair V. Mystery
storyline: This top down 2.5D ghost story mystery will take the player through a Louisiana inspired neighborhood haunting. Using foresight, Clair and the player work their way through the looping narrative of one day, to uncover as much of the pieces to the puzzle behind the lingering apparition. Using Spirit Vision, Clair leaves their body in an astral form to explore the history of the place and dig deeper into the truth of the festering catalyst of its haunting. The recently developed neighborhood of Myrtle Grove is filled with an awkward anxiety. The source is the ghost, but is there more affecting the safety or social dynamics of the community? Explore the subdivision as Clair and talk to the curious batch of residents. Behind every lingering spirit is an unresolved tragedy. Do you have the courage to find it?
summary: When renowned P.I. Clair V. Is called to a Louisiana town on reports of a ghost, what they find is a mystery cloaked in a nightly calamity. With spirit abilities and the gift of foresight, Clair must loop through futures to uncover the roots of the haunting and stop a curse.
